notes: Drafted comprehensive test plan for Section 3.5 Responsive Design in the Phase 4 priority plan. Expanded from a 12-line stub to a full section with 142 test scenarios across 5 categories: 62 pure function tests (ResponsiveUtils.js), 32 CSS/DOM validation tests, 12 pointer event compatibility tests, 12 integration tests, and 24 E2E Playwright tests. Consulted world-review for real-world UX considerations (viewport breakpoints, touch-action CSS, virtual keyboard interference, browser-specific quirks) and planner for structured test design following the established Section 3.1-3.4 format. Key insights incorporated: three-tier layout (desktop ≥1200px, tablet 768-1199px, mobile <768px), pointer events handle both mouse and touch natively, touch-action: none critical for canvas, 44x44px WCAG touch target minimum, no pinch-to-zoom on canvas (fixed 1920x1080 logical resolution), and export resolution unchanged by viewport. Added deferred automated verification checklist, deferred critical files list, and deferred manual verification items to the plan's success criteria section.
